title: Bracket: reverse match order
brief: The match listing shows teams in wrong order. Reverse each pair so the home team comes first.
text:
Away: Lakers vs Celtics
Away: Warriors vs Bulls
Away: Heat vs Nets

expect.text:
Away: Celtics vs Lakers
Away: Bulls vs Warriors
Away: Nets vs Heat

why: Substitution with capture groups swaps the two team names while preserving the prefix.
author: claude (daily)
